linkedResearchUpgrades.description: Monitor the PKD2L1 cerebrospinal-fluid-contacting-neuron SBF-SEM study as the closest biologically qualifying mouse-spinal interneuron internal-detail candidate found. The paper identifies GABAergic PKD2L1-positive spinal interneurons and reports targeted same-cell serial block-face EM, but no stable public raw stack, section series, segmentation, mesh or source-to-figure object manifest was located. Publication images and measurements cannot substitute for downloadable calibrated voxels or establish a reusable cell object. Admission remains blocked until the authors or a repository deposit stable object IDs, raw calibrated 3D pixels, same-cell membrane/cell segmentation and labelled nucleus, organelle or synapse objects, coordinate/voxel metadata, bytes, cryptographic checksums, object-level reuse rights and raw-versus-mask overlay QC. Until then the runtime renders zero PKD2L1 geometry or internals and makes no atlas registration, complete-cell, prevalence or general-interneuron claim

linkedResearchUpgrades.description: Add exactly one source-local PKD2L1 CSF-contacting-neuron functional profile from Figshare version `10.6084/m9.figshare.29430869.v2`. The deterministic contract records the official CC BY 4.0 92-file / 1,848,613-byte inventory and pins seven key objects by file ID, bytes, publisher MD5 and locally verified SHA-256. It preserves 3–6-week cervical/thoracic/lumbar scope; exact firing-pattern denominators (C N=10/n=21, T N=12/n=23, L N=9/n=21); paper N=191/n=659 versus 654 deposited passive-property rows; N=25/n=125 resting-potential observations; and exact anatomy FOV/cell totals. Four conflicts remain quarantined: paper-versus-workbook firing p values, incomplete/no-denominator firing-location coverage, 659-versus-654 passive-property rows, and thoracic 6-week distance n=478 versus FOV n=457. The deposit contains observation tables but no globally stable cell key: tonic/single-spike, segment, quadrant and experiment-family rows stay nested evidence rather than new types. The UI exposes observed cohort/experiment-family electrophysiology while retaining zero raw traces, microscopy volume, morphology, geometry, internal objects, atlas registration, whole-deposit per-cell join or link to the separate UPG-168 SBF-SEM study
